_comment: The record of where every image on the Tanu's page came from. Eight of the eleven are the client's own files, downloaded from tanus.uk on 10 September 2026 and re-encoded for the web — original hash-named source file, crop and final size are all recorded below so the provenance survives. Three were generated, because the client had no picture for those slots; each is a still life of empty clay vessels rather than of food, so that nothing generated can be mistaken for a photograph of what you are buying. The generator script writes and rewrites the generated entries (and re-sorts the file when it does — restore this order by hand); the downloaded entries are maintained by hand and a re-run leaves them alone.
_todo: TODO — confirm Tanu's holds the licence to publish flavour-mishti-doi, flavour-blush-rose, flavour-emerald-bliss and flavour-saffron-indulgence, and that they photograph its own product. All four are studio shots lit and styled identically on the same grey stone, and they read as stock rather than as pictures of a home kitchen. hero-baked-doi and og-card are plainly Tanu's own and carry no such doubt.

hero-baked-doi.processing: Re-encoded from 1200x1600 JPEG to 1100x1467, quality 82, progressive. No crop.
hero-baked-doi.alt: A wide, shallow terracotta dish of baked misti doi, set firm and glossy and freckled with red saffron threads, standing on a white plate at the end of a laid table under warm indoor light. Tanu's own photograph, published on tanus.uk.

og-card.processing: Cropped from the same 1200x1600 original to the band y=870..1500, giving exactly 1200x630 with the dish filling the frame. Quality 84.
og-card.alt: A wide, shallow terracotta dish of saffron-freckled baked misti doi, set and glossy, photographed on a laid table under warm indoor light. Tanu's own photograph, from tanus.uk.

logo-crest.processing: Resized from 1254x1254 to 200x200, alpha preserved, PNG optimised. It never renders larger than 46 CSS pixels, so 200 covers a 4x display and saves 160 KB over a 400px file.
logo-crest.altNote: Intentionally empty. The emblem is always rendered immediately beside the wordmark "Tanu's", so alt text on it would make a screen reader announce the name twice.

flavour-mishti-doi.processing: Flattened from 1024x1024 PNG to 800x800 JPEG, quality 80. The card renders at roughly 350 CSS pixels.
flavour-mishti-doi.alt: A shallow terracotta bowl of plain baked misti doi, pale cream and swirled smooth right to the rim, photographed from above on a grey stone surface with chopped pistachio scattered beside it.

flavour-blush-rose.processing: Flattened from 1024x1024 PNG to 800x800 JPEG, quality 80. The card renders at roughly 350 CSS pixels.
flavour-blush-rose.alt: A shallow terracotta bowl of pale pink rose misti doi on grey stone, scattered across one side with dried rose petals and slivered pistachio, a worn brass spoon and two pink roses lying alongside.

flavour-emerald-bliss.processing: Flattened from 1024x1024 PNG to 800x800 JPEG, quality 80. The card renders at roughly 350 CSS pixels.
flavour-emerald-bliss.alt: A shallow terracotta bowl of pistachio misti doi on grey stone, pale gold with a bright green pistachio drizzle looping across the middle and crushed pistachios banked up either side of it.

flavour-saffron-indulgence.processing: Flattened from 1536x1024 PNG to 800x534 JPEG, quality 80. The card renders at roughly 350 CSS pixels.
flavour-saffron-indulgence.alt: A close view of a terracotta bowl of saffron misti doi resting on undyed linen, deep cream in colour and freckled all over with fine red saffron threads, with a brass spoon at the edge of the frame.

band-empty-bhaar.processing: Generated at 3168x1344, then resized to 1600x679, quality 82, to keep the page weight sane.
band-empty-bhaar.alt: Empty unglazed terracotta pots of the traditional bhaar shape standing upside down in a row along a pale stone bench, with a coil of plain cotton string and a folded sheet of brown paper beside them. An illustration of the vessel misti doi is set in — not a photograph of Tanu's kitchen.
band-empty-bhaar.altNote: The last sentence is not optional. The frame contains a window and a stone bench and could otherwise be read as Tanu's own kitchen, which it is not.
band-empty-bhaar.prompt: A wide horizontal still life on a pale grey-white stone worktop. Six or seven small unglazed red-brown terracotta pots of the traditional Bengali bhaar shape — squat, round-bellied, wide-mouthed, rough-thrown, unfinished on the outside — stand empty and upside down in a loose row, with two more stacked rim to rim at the right. Their surfaces are matte and slightly dusty with clay. Beside them lies a length of plain undyed cotton string and a folded square of unprinted brown paper. Soft diffused daylight rakes in from the left, casting long soft shadows across the stone. Nothing in the pots, no food anywhere in the frame, no people, no lettering of any kind.
band-empty-bhaar.style: Warm, quiet food still-life photography with no food in it: unglazed red-brown terracotta vessels on a pale grey-white stone surface, soft diffused daylight from one side, gentle shadows, a shallow depth of field, muted natural colour with warm terracotta against cool stone, nothing styled or glossy, the calm of a working kitchen bench before anything has been made

band-clay-wall.processing: Generated at 3168x1344, then resized to 1600x679, quality 82, to keep the page weight sane.
band-clay-wall.alt: A close view of empty unglazed terracotta pots on a pale stone worktop, showing the rough, porous clay of their walls. An illustration of the kind of vessel misti doi is traditionally set in, not a photograph of Tanu's kitchen.
band-clay-wall.altNote: The last sentence is not optional. The frame contains a window and a stone bench and could otherwise be read as Tanu's own kitchen, which it is not.
band-clay-wall.prompt: A close, low-angle still life of three empty unglazed red-brown terracotta bhaar pots on a pale grey-white stone worktop, the nearest one filling the left third of the frame and turned slightly so its rim and the rough outside wall are both visible. The clay is matte, porous and uneven, with fine pits, thumb-marks from the wheel and a faint pale dusting of dried clay; the inside of the rim is bare and dry. The other two stand behind it, softly out of focus. Soft diffused daylight from the left picks out the grain of the clay. The pots are completely empty, nothing inside them or anywhere in the frame, no people, no lettering of any kind.
band-clay-wall.style: Warm, quiet food still-life photography with no food in it: unglazed red-brown terracotta vessels on a pale grey-white stone surface, soft diffused daylight from one side, gentle shadows, a shallow depth of field, muted natural colour with warm terracotta against cool stone, nothing styled or glossy, the calm of a working kitchen bench before anything has been made

band-folded-linen.processing: Generated at 3168x1344, then resized to 1600x679, quality 82, to keep the page weight sane.
band-folded-linen.alt: An empty terracotta pot lying on its side on a pale stone worktop beside a folded plain cotton cloth and a brass spoon. An illustration, not a photograph of Tanu's kitchen.
band-folded-linen.altNote: The last sentence is not optional. The frame contains a window and a stone bench and could otherwise be read as Tanu's own kitchen, which it is not.
band-folded-linen.prompt: A wide, sparse still life on a pale grey-white stone worktop. At the right of the frame a single empty unglazed red-brown terracotta bhaar pot lies on its side, mouth facing the camera, showing the bare dry clay inside. To its left a square of plain undyed cotton cloth is folded neatly into a flat rectangle, with a worn brass spoon resting across it. The left half of the frame is mostly empty stone. Soft diffused daylight from the left, long gentle shadows, quiet and orderly. Nothing edible, no people, no paper, no lettering of any kind.
band-folded-linen.style: Warm, quiet food still-life photography with no food in it: unglazed red-brown terracotta vessels on a pale grey-white stone surface, soft diffused daylight from one side, gentle shadows, a shallow depth of field, muted natural colour with warm terracotta against cool stone, nothing styled or glossy, the calm of a working kitchen bench before anything has been made

box-tasting-four.alt: An open kraft box holding four small terracotta pots, each sealed with brown paper and string, on a pale stone worktop. An illustration of the gift box, not a photograph of Tanu's product.
box-tasting-four.prompt: An overhead-angled still life on a pale grey-white stone worktop. An open shallow box of plain unbleached kraft card holds four small unglazed red-brown terracotta bhaar pots in a neat two-by-two grid, each pot's mouth closed with a round of plain brown paper tied down with undyed cotton string, so nothing inside is visible. The lid of the box leans against the right side. A loose length of string and a single dried marigold flower lie on the stone beside it. Soft diffused daylight from the left, gentle shadows. No food visible anywhere, no people, no lettering of any kind.
box-tasting-four.style: Warm, quiet food still-life photography with no food in it: unglazed red-brown terracotta vessels on a pale grey-white stone surface, soft diffused daylight from one side, gentle shadows, a shallow depth of field, muted natural colour with warm terracotta against cool stone, nothing styled or glossy, the calm of a working kitchen bench before anything has been made
box-tasting-four.processing: Generated at 2400x1792, resized to 1200x896, JPEG quality 80, progressive.

box-celebration.alt: Rows of small terracotta pots sealed with brown paper and string on a linen-covered table, with marigold petals scattered between them. An illustration of an event order, not a photograph of Tanu's product.
box-celebration.prompt: A wide still life on a long table covered with plain undyed linen. Rows of small unglazed red-brown terracotta bhaar pots, about twenty of them, stand in loose lines, each mouth closed with a round of plain brown paper tied with undyed cotton string, so nothing inside is visible. A few scattered orange and yellow marigold petals and one brass tray at the edge of the frame. Soft warm afternoon daylight from the left, shallow depth of field so the far pots fall softly out of focus. No food visible, no people, no hands, no lettering of any kind.
